title: Gold-backed note chalao
instruction: Cards ko order mein chalao: gold reserve se note issue karo, phir holder ka note gold mein redeem karo. Aakhir mein extra issue par backing constraint lagao.

pieces.label: Central bank: gold reserve rakho
pieces.right: Backing taiyar hai. Note ki value paper se nahi, gold dene ke promise se aayegi.
pieces.wrong: Reserve ke bina gold dene ke promise ki backing missing rahegi.

pieces.label: Gold-backed paper notes issue karo
pieces.right: Paper holder ko fixed quantity of gold lene ka claim mila; paper ki apni intrinsic value bahut kam hai.
pieces.wrong: Backing arrange hone se pehle issue karne par redemption promise support nahi hota.

pieces.label: Holder: note redemption ko lao
pieces.right: Holder demand par exchange maang raha hai; book ke mutabik yeh facility principle mein available thi.
pieces.wrong: Note issue hi nahi hua toh holder redeem karne ke liye kya laayega?

pieces.label: Fixed quantity ka gold do
pieces.right: Note fixed gold quantity mein badla. Isi redemption promise se note ko value milti hai.
pieces.wrong: Holder ka note aaye bina redemption adhura hai; arbitrary quantity dena fixed-redemption promise todega.

pieces.label: Extra issue ko gold backing se baandho
pieces.right: Har note ko gold backing chahiye, isliye excessive printing par constraint laga.
pieces.wrong: Backing se alag unlimited issue karoge toh sab notes ke redemption promise ko support nahi kar paoge.

win: Valuable paper nahi, credible gold-redemption promise tha; backing ne excessive issue ko constrain kiya.
